name: com.aiseewhy/aiseewhy
title: AISeeWhy
description: Can ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity crawlers read your page? Audit, fixes, compare, monitoring.

tools.name: show_ai_crawler_check
tools.description: Check one page for AI crawlers and AI search (the same check and limits as audit_url) and show the result as a visual card in apps that render one (ChatGPT, Claude): the score, which AI crawlers are let in or blocked, the costliest finding with its fix and how many findings are locked, by priority. Use it when the user wants to see a site's AI crawler access at a glance; use audit_url for a Markdown report.

url.description: Page to audit: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com (https is assumed).
url.title: Url

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Audit one URL: fetch it as 16 AI and search crawlers plus curl and a browser, check robots.txt, structured data, answer-first content, freshness, hreflang and llms.txt, plus classic on-page SEO (title, meta description, H1, canonical, noindex, image alt text, broken links). Returns a Markdown report with findings and fixes. language: report language code (en, de, ja, …).

url.description: Page to audit: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com (https is assumed).
url.title: Url

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

bots.description: Only test these crawlers, by name (for example GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended). Omit to test all 16 AI and search crawlers.
bots.title: Bots

tools.name: audit_sitemap
tools.description: Audit up to 10 pages listed in a sitemap or sitemap index. Returns one summary line per page plus the full report of every page with findings. Needs an API key.

sitemap_url.description: URL of a sitemap.xml or sitemap index, for example https://example.com/sitemap.xml.
sitemap_url.title: Sitemap Url

max_urls.description: How many page URLs from the sitemap to audit, 1 to 10.
max_urls.title: Max Urls

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explain a finding id (e.g. access.blocked, robots.disallowed, schema.software_no_offers) in the given language: what it means, why it matters for AI search and how to fix it.

finding_id.description: Finding id exactly as shown in an audit report, for example access.blocked or llms.missing.
finding_id.title: Finding Id

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: compare_urls
tools.description: Audit 2 or 3 URLs (yours and competitors') and compare them side by side: score, P1/P2/P3 counts, blocked crawlers, llms.txt, structured data, text without JavaScript. Needs an API key.

urls.description: 2 or 3 page URLs or domains to compare; put your own page first.
urls.title: Urls

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: SEO site audit: crawl up to 50 pages (up to 90 seconds) of a site from a start page by following internal links (then the sitemap), as a browser and respecting robots.txt. Reports broken and redirected internal links, duplicate titles and descriptions, orphan, deep and thin pages, sitemap entries that are noindex, redirect or name another canonical, and on-page SEO problems counted across pages. Needs an API key.

url.description: Start page of the crawl, usually the home page: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com. Only pages on the same host are crawled.
url.title: Url

max_pages.description: How many pages to crawl, 1 to 50.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: find_broken_links
tools.description: Broken link finder: read a page and the pages of the same site it links to, level by level (depth 0 is the start page only; up to 50 pages and 90 seconds), and check every link found once: pages, other sites and images. Returns the broken links with the link text and the pages that contain them, apart from links that could not be verified (blocked, rate limited, slow) and redirects. Respects robots.txt for pages it walks into. Needs an API key.

url.description: Start page: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com. Only pages on the same host are walked; links to other sites are checked but not followed.
url.title: Url

depth.description: Levels of pages to follow from the start page, 0 to 3.
depth.title: Depth

max_pages.description: How many pages to read, 1 to 50.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

tools.name: get_all_pages_performance
tools.description: Every page of the site with clicks, impressions, CTR, position, trend, page category (winner, zero click, high impressions low CTR, declining, cannibalized, not indexable) and recommended action. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

category.description: Only pages in this category: winner, zero_click, high_impressions_low_ctr, declining, cannibalized, low_traffic, not_indexable, no_data.
category.title: Category

tools.name: find_zero_click_pages
tools.description: Pages with zero recorded clicks in the last 90 days, each with a verdict (KEEP, OPTIMIZE, MERGE, REDIRECT or REVIEW FOR REMOVAL) and the evidence. A trigger for review, never for automatic deletion; pages Search Console returned nothing for are reported as unknown, not as zero. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: find_high_impression_low_ctr_pages
tools.description: Pages Google shows often that users rarely click, with the query, the position, the CTR that is normal there and what is wrong with the title, description or query match. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: find_declining_pages
tools.description: Pages losing organic clicks against the previous comparable period, with the likely cause (ranking loss, lower demand, cannibalization, CTR loss, technical indexing, outdated content) and the action. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: detect_keyword_cannibalization
tools.description: Groups of URLs competing for the same search queries: shared queries, intent and content similarity, the primary page, the recommended action and a confidence score. Separates harmful cannibalization from legitimate multiple rankings. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: identify_strongest_page
tools.description: The strongest URL of each group of competing pages, scored on clicks, history, query coverage, ranking stability, intent match, content, internal links, canonical setup and business value, with every component shown (the page with the most clicks does not always win). Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

url.description: Only the group that contains this URL.
url.title: Url

tools.name: find_content_consolidation_candidates
tools.description: Groups of pages that should be merged or redirected into a stronger page, with what to do with each competing page and why. Pages with a distinct intent are kept. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: generate_redirect_plan
tools.description: A 301 redirect plan for redundant pages: source, destination, reason, Search Console evidence, intent similarity, confidence, risk, required content migration and internal links to update. Detects chains, loops, canonical conflicts and irrelevant destinations. Proposals only: nothing is executed and every redirect needs your approval. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: generate_content_merge_plan
tools.description: For each consolidation group: the content and queries to move into the target page, improvements to the target, internal links to update, sitemap and canonical changes and a validation plan. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: prioritize_seo_opportunities
tools.description: A ranked P1-P3 action queue to grow organic traffic from existing pages (consolidate, fix snippets, recover declines, fix indexing, add internal links) with a transparent score, exact steps and impact split into measured numbers and labelled estimates. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

tools.name: watch_site
tools.description: Add a URL to the account's scheduled monitoring (freq: daily or weekly). The owner gets an email when a check finds a new P1 problem or the score drops by 10 or more. Needs an API key; adding the same URL again only changes the frequency.

url.description: Page to monitor: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com.
url.title: Url

freq.description: How often to check the page: daily or weekly (default).
freq.title: Freq

tools.name: list_watched_sites
tools.description: List the URLs this account monitors, with the frequency, last score and last check time. Needs an API key.
